audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows were wrong relative to the page's own whys — the chart gave Renekton levels 2, 3 and both item stages while whys[2] through whys[6] say Poppy owns everything from level 3 on.
audit.why: Poppy's Steadfast Presence counters Renekton's only engage tool, which is why the lane inverts at 3 and never comes back. The Poppy-side mirror already re-proposed all seven rows as Renekton, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy with ratings 3/5/6/6/6/6/7 from her side.
audit.corrected: Renekton, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy in both layers as one atomic group, ratings inverted to 7/5/4/4/4/4/3.

audit.why: The spikes correctly place the swing at level 3 (Steadfast Presence) rather than at an item, and level 6 and first item after it. Keeper's Verdict is 140s at rank 1, which is why it reads as a fight-reset rather than a repeatable threat.
sources: kit: Poppy W and R cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Three things. (a) Steadfast Presence was described as slowing you — Riot's text says a stopped dash leaves the enemy slowed AND GROUNDED, so your second Slice and Dice cast is denied too and you cannot dice out. (b) Its cooldown was written as '16 seconds base' and 'a 16-second window'; it is 20s at rank 1 and only reaches 16s at rank 3. (c) Keeper's Verdict is a channel, so your empowered W stun interrupts it, and Iron Ambassador's buckler shield is destroyed outright by an empowered W.
audit.why: Poppy W text: 'stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded', cd 20/18/16/14/12. Poppy R: 'Poppy channels a hammer strike', with the channel flag. Poppy P: 'Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield'. Renekton W: 'destroying damage shields on the target'. The missingInteractions file flags both untargetable-dodges-burst and shield-absorbs-burst here.
audit.corrected: The grounding is now stated where it changes behaviour (you lose the escape, not just the entry); the cooldown is corrected to 20s at rank 1 in both places; the channel-interrupt and the buckler destruction are added.
sources: kit: Poppy P/W/R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] claims Heroic Charge is 'a 1.5-second stun' and that Poppy follows with a 'Q knockup'.
audit.why: Riot gives no stun duration for Heroic Charge, and Hammer Shock is a slow zone that explodes after a delay — there is no knockup on her Q. The 1.5s figure looks borrowed from Renekton's own empowered stun.
audit.corrected: The line now gives Heroic Charge's real 14s rank-1 cooldown and describes her Q as the slow zone it is.
sources: kit: Poppy E text and cd 14/13/12/11/10

edits.before: Activate Steadfast Presence the instant you E in to slow you and deny the whole combo
edits.after: Activate Steadfast Presence as you E in — a stopped dash leaves you slowed and grounded

edits.before: Heroic Charge you into a wall for a 1.5-second stun and follow with Q knockup
edits.after: Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1) you into a wall to stun, then Q the slow zone on top

edits.before: Engage only when Steadfast Presence is on cooldown — it is a 16-second window you must track
edits.after: Engage only when Steadfast Presence is down — 20s at rank 1, falling to 12s at rank 5

edits.before: Poppy wastes Heroic Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: At 50+ Fury your W deletes her Iron Ambassador buckler shield.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Heroic Charge: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. When it is down — W-stun + Q her.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence grounds a stopped dash; her R is a channel your W stun interrupts.

edits.before: From Level 3 onward Poppy owns this lane because Steadfast Presence counters your entire engage tool. Do not blindly E into her — wait for W to be on cooldown (16 seconds base) and only then commit your pattern. If you land empowered W before she can reach a wall, you win the short burst trade and Q heals enough to walk away cleanly; if she tags you into a wall with Heroic Charge first, the stun plus Q knockup combo will chunk you badly. At Level 6 your Dominus HP buffer does not save you from Keeper's Verdict launching you away — pop R before she can charge her ult channel and force the all-in fast rather than letting her reset with a knockback.
edits.after: From Level 3 onward Poppy owns this lane because Steadfast Presence counters your entire engage tool. Do not blindly E into her — wait for W to be down (20s at rank 1) and only then commit, because a stopped dash leaves you grounded and you cannot dice back out either. If you land empowered W before she reaches a wall, you win the short burst trade and Q heals enough to walk away cleanly; if she tags you into a wall with Heroic Charge first, the stun plus her Q slow zone will chunk you badly. Keeper's Verdict is a channel, so an empowered W stun cancels it outright — hold your stun for the wind-up rather than spending it on the approach.

notes: The packet suspectName 'Use Keeper's Verdict' in wants.foe[2] is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Poppy's real R name. All seven chart rows are proposed as matched full/content pairs in one group, matching the already-audited Poppy side. The single highest-value change on this page is the grounding clause: the player was told Steadfast Presence stops the dash IN, when Riot's text grounds you afterwards, which is what actually kills the escape half of the combo — and the escape is the half the page elsewhere says people forget.
